column3: The pack ceiling is 80 MB and a repository past it is re-fetched with filter blob:none, which keeps commits and trees and drops file contents
column4: a 330 MB pack crashed the workerd runtime in the prototype, and the ceiling must degrade rather than kill the isolate; the download is streamed and cancelled at the cap so the oversized pack is never held
column5: vercel/next.js full history crashed workerd at ~330 MB; the fixture test 'keeps history only when the full pack passes the ceiling' clones with maxBytes 1200, lands on partial=1, answers diff with patch null and show through one extra want
column6: accepted; a repository too large even for a history-only clone is refused with a message
